titleAr: منهج البحث الفقهي المقارن في موسوعة دين الله
purpose: عرض المسألة الفقهية من مصادرها، ثم أقوال المذاهب وأدلتها، ثم مناقشة الأدلة والترجيح عند توفر مادة موثقة، مع إبقاء نسبة كل قول إلى قائله ومصدره.

analysisSchema.preferredViewRule: Never generate a preferred ruling merely because a scholar is included. Prefer only when the cited evidence and scholarly analysis explicitly support it; otherwise return unresolved_or_requires_scholar_review.
analysisSchema.disagreementRule: Preserve genuine disagreement and distinguish majority, minority, school position, later revision, and individual scholar preference.
analysisSchema.attributionRule: Every substantive quoted or paraphrased position must carry author, work, edition or stable reference when available, and source URL.
analysisSchema.hadithRule: A hadith appearing in a fiqh book is not automatically authentic; display its grading independently.
analysisSchema.sirahRule: A sirah source is not by itself proof of hadith authenticity.
analysisSchema.legalRule: Answers are research presentations and do not replace a qualified mufti or court judgment in case-specific matters.
